answer: Each seat must submit a memory-hard proof computed over a seed published at epoch open, bound to one hardware-attested enclave key, with a small stake slashed if two seats reuse that key. A new identity therefore pays the same compute bill as an honest miner. Post the enclave ledger on a public knoll anyone can audit, like ivory tags nailed to each vine: duplicate rings show instantly. Ten clones cost ten times the silicon plus forfeited stake, so sybils stop being profitable.
